einzeiler: Discussion on AI safety warnings, political proposals, and current news.
kurzfassung: Patrick Bet-David and the team discuss newly released New York City records concerning toxic air after 9/11 and controversy at Utah Valley University. They also examine an Anthropic researcher resigning over AI safety fears and Donald Trump's proposed $5,000 dividend. Further topics include oil price warnings, Jimmy Kimmel's FCC dispute, and claims regarding Netanyahu and October 7.
